ability.name: Machine Context Check
ability.description: Determine host platform, domain membership status, current identity, and available system privileges using native OS queries.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $id = whoami /all 2>&1; $priv = whoami /priv 2>&1; $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem -ErrorAction Stop; $dom = $cs.PartOfDomain; $dn = $cs.Domain; $os = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction Stop).Caption; $hn = $env:COMPUTERNAME; $adapters = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 } | ForEach-Object { $b = ([System.Net.IPAddress]$_.IPAddress).GetAddressBytes(); $mk = [System.BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]([Math]::Pow(2,32)-[Math]::Pow(2,32-$_.PrefixLength))); if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($mk) }; $net = (0..3|ForEach-Object{$b[$_]-band $mk[$_]}) -join '.'; "ADAPTER: $($_.InterfaceAlias)  IP: $($_.IPAddress)  CIDR: $net/$($_.PrefixLength)" }; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "OS: $os"; $adapters | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_ALL ---"; $id; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_PRIV ---"; $priv; $localAdmins = net localgroup administrators 2>&1; Write-Output "--- LOCAL_ADMINS ---"; $localAdmins } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step0_windows $($_.Exception.Message)" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step0.txt

rationale: Initial foothold evaluation determines the operating parameters, OS versions, and structural domains of our target, allowing us to pivot or adapt silently without dropping custom tools prematurely.
